_scenario_name: Zenith Cap — Dubai DIFC holdco, Indian founders, IN engineer exercises
_narrative: Zenith Cap is a Dubai DIFC-incorporated holding company (Indian founders flipped from Delaware in 2025). Most engineering remains at Zenith Tech India Pvt Ltd in Gurugram. A principal engineer exercises 10,000 NSOs at USD 1.00 strike, FMV USD 6.00 on 1 May 2026. Founder's question: does the Dubai parent owe anything? No — UAE has no personal income tax. The full incidence is on India via §17(2)(vi) perquisite tax.
